depiction.primary_object: four ascending vertical signal strength bars split horizontally
depiction.composition: four ascending vertical bars with horizontal gap and bottom-right exclamation mark

readings.meaning: cellular network issue or dual SIM signal warning
mobile data connection error or weak reception

ambiguity: The horizontal split (representing dual SIM signal in Android UI) makes the bars look like a stacked bar chart or abstract equalizer, and at small sizes the exclamation mark merges into the fourth bar.

modifier_semantics.meaning: error, warning, problem, or no connection
dual SIM or two separate signal channels

reasoning: This is an OS status-bar indicator (specifically Android's dual-SIM signal bars with an exclamation mark for no data/connection). As a UI status/signal-bars glyph, it is mainly interface chrome representing a system state rather than a concrete task object, though it can occasionally fit narrow cellular troubleshooting tasks.
